name: Being Negative
overview: Scripture teaches that guarding our hearts is essential because our thoughts and words shape the course of our lives, and we will give account for every idle word spoken. Believers are called to resist conformity to worldly patterns by renewing their minds through God's truth, focusing on what is pure, honest, and praiseworthy. Prayer with thanksgiving replaces anxiety, enabling a Christ-centered perspective that aligns with God's perfect will. The Word of God penetrates deeply, discerning our innermost thoughts and intentions, guiding us away from negativity toward life-giving attitudes.
